newsitem.title: UK: INSIGHT - Bunds must conquer 101.99 for upside.
newsitem.headline: INSIGHT - Bunds must conquer 101.99 for upside.

text.p: September Bund futures on LIFFE will bump into overhead supply on Wednesday and are likely to drift lower to consolidate latest gains, analysts said.
The downside should be limited to 101.62, which is the 61.8 percent retracement level of Tuesday's rally, they said.

"We're probably going to have a bit of trouble here. We've got to see that (101.99 on Monday) cleared to target higher levels. It looks to me like pretty serious resistance," said Anne Whitby, head of technical analysis at 4CAST.
September has cleared 101.92, but further gains will be hard-fought, she said. By 0707 GMT, it was 0.11 up at 101.99.
